n1c57d5f6fea.s:
Consider the following about the sources of India's national income:
1. Services is the largest sectoral source.
2. The household sector is the largest institutional source.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n1c57d5f6fea.x: Services is the largest source by sector, and the household sector (largely unorganised) is the largest institutional source.

n7bd0b0cd119.s: Under the World Bank's GNI per capita (Atlas method) classification, India is a:
n7bd0b0cd119.x: India remains a lower-middle-income economy by the World Bank's Atlas-method GNI per capita classification, updated each 1 July.

n3915060f965.s: By GDP measured at purchasing power parity, India ranks:
n3915060f965.x: India is the 3rd largest economy by PPP GDP, after the United States and China (ICP 2021); by nominal GDP it is 4th.

n82fbcfba993.s:
Consider the following about the 16th Finance Commission:
1. It introduced a contribution criterion based on the square root of GSDP.
2. It reduced devolution to 25 percent.
3. It retained the per capita GSDP income-distance criterion.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n82fbcfba993.x: The new contribution criterion uses the square root of GSDP and the income-distance criterion remains; devolution stays at 41 percent, not 25 percent.

nf90d7a7a4f1.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Advance and quarterly GDP estimates – NSO (MoSPI)
nf90d7a7a4f1.x: Advance and quarterly estimates are issued by NSO (MoSPI); Global Economic Prospects is a World Bank publication and monetary policy projections come from the RBI.

nd14c6c79e51.s: India's overall literacy rate rose from 18.33% in 1951 to ____ in 2011.
nd14c6c79e51.x: India's overall literacy rate rose from 18.33% in 1951 to 72.98% in 2011.

n7ed4fe2bb23.s: According to Census 2011, Muslims formed what share of India's population?
n7ed4fe2bb23.x: In 2011 Muslims were 14.2% (Hindus 79.8%); 9.8% was the Muslim share in 1951.

nde2e6c49c99.s: Which enumeration is Census 2027, with population enumeration from February 2027, set to include?
nde2e6c49c99.x: Census 2027 is to include caste enumeration, with population enumeration beginning in February 2027.

na2c93ba3792.s: Kerala's 60+ population is projected to reach what share by 2036, signalling the end of its demographic dividend?
na2c93ba3792.x: Kerala's 60+ population is projected at 22.8% by 2036, marking the end of its demographic-dividend phase.

n92ebd57b321.s:
Assertion (A): States such as Kerala and Tamil Nadu face increasing pressure on pension-related social expenditure.
Reason (R): These States are ageing, and their working-age population share is already falling.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n92ebd57b321.x: Both are true: ageing and a falling working-age share explain the higher pension-related expenditure pressure in these States.

n0ac1e891c35.s: The National Family Health Survey is conducted by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare through:
o: International Institute for Population Sciences, Mumbai
n0ac1e891c35.x: NFHS is a Ministry of Health and Family Welfare survey conducted through IIPS, Mumbai. (Restyled as a one-liner; the original was not a true sequence question.)

nd184c4b3b58.s: Which Constitutional Amendment allowed readjustment of constituency boundaries on the basis of the 2001 Census, without changing the number of seats?
nd184c4b3b58.x: The 87th Amendment (2003) allowed boundary readjustment on the 2001 Census; the 84th extended the seat freeze and the 42nd froze seats on the 1971 Census.

n90b36e23b99.s:
Consider the following pairs (group – main reason for migration):
1. Women – Marriage
2. Men – Work
Which of the above pairs is/are correctly matched?
n90b36e23b99.x: Marriage is the major reason for women's migration and work is the major reason for men's migration.

ndd97aa487e6.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Push-pull theory and intervening obstacles – Everett Lee
2. Expected-income rural-urban model – Michael Todaro
3. Laws of Migration – E.G. Ravenstein
Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
ndd97aa487e6.x: Lee gave push-pull with intervening obstacles, Todaro the expected-income model and Ravenstein the Laws of Migration.

n00af621ccae.s: Andhra Pradesh's draft Population Management Policy (March 2026) shifts the emphasis from population control to:
n00af621ccae.x: The draft policy marks a shift from population control to population management.

n9f1611990d8.s: Which of the following pillar – focus pairs is correctly matched?
n9f1611990d8.x: Kshema refers to elderly care; Matrutva is maternal health, Shakti women's work participation and Naipunyam skills.

n436fd568221.s: According to Engel's Law, as family income rises, the share of income spent on food:
n436fd568221.x: Engel's Law: the proportion of income spent on food declines as income rises, though the absolute amount may increase.

n6c85e84c109.s: Sustainable Development Goal 1 aims to end poverty in all its forms everywhere by:
n6c85e84c109.x: SDG 1 is to end poverty in all its forms everywhere by 2030.

nindian-economy-34-1.s: The Alagh Task Force, which set the first calorie-based poverty line, was constituted in:
nindian-economy-34-1.x: The Alagh Task Force (1979) set the first poverty line based on calorie needs: 2,400 kcal rural and 2,100 kcal urban.

nindian-economy-34-2.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
nindian-economy-34-2.x: The Rangarajan Committee reported in 2014, not 2009; 2009 is the Tendulkar report.

nfcd6b69a8a3.s: Which statement correctly distinguishes URP from MRP?
o: URP uses a 365-day recall for all items; MRP uses 30 days for all items
URP uses a 7-day recall for food; MRP uses 30 days for all items
URP uses a 365-day recall for low-frequency items; MRP uses 30 days for all items
URP uses a 30-day recall for all items; MRP uses 365 days for five low-frequency items
nfcd6b69a8a3.x: URP uses a 30-day recall for all items; MRP uses a 365-day recall for five low-frequency items such as clothing, footwear, durables, education and institutional medical care.

ne9e8e155c5d.s: Higher agricultural poverty in Rayalaseema, compared with the delta districts, is mainly attributed to its greater dependence on:
ne9e8e155c5d.x: Delta districts benefit from better irrigation and higher productivity, while rain-fed Rayalaseema faces greater agricultural vulnerability and poverty.

na3c2a80341e.s:
Consider the following about the regional pattern of poverty in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Rayalaseema and North Coastal Andhra are poorer regions.
2. Delta districts are generally the least poor.
3. Rayalaseema is the least poor region.
Which of the above statements are correct?
na3c2a80341e.x: Poverty is higher in Rayalaseema (e.g. Kurnool, Anantapur) and North Coastal Andhra, while delta districts are generally least poor; so statement 3 is false.

n2017c040337.s: The Gini coefficient is derived from the Lorenz curve as:
o: Area under the Lorenz curve ÷ whole area under the equality line
Area between the Lorenz curve and the equality line ÷ area under the Lorenz curve
Area between the Lorenz curve and the equality line ÷ whole area under the equality line
Slope of the Lorenz curve at the median
n2017c040337.x: The Gini coefficient is the area between the Lorenz curve and the equality line divided by the whole area under the equality line.

n6325310e448.s: The Environmental Kuznets Curve, with per-capita income on the X-axis and environmental degradation on the Y-axis, is:
n6325310e448.x: Degradation first rises with income, peaks and then falls, giving an inverted-U shape.

n2267142dc4e.s: Which one of the following is the defining test for identifying disguised unemployment?
o: Withdrawal of some workers leaves total output unchanged
Workers remain unemployed throughout the business cycle
Workers change jobs frequently in search of higher wages
Withdrawal of some workers reduces total output proportionately
n2267142dc4e.x: In disguised unemployment, removing some workers does not reduce total output, implying zero marginal productivity.

nc5e8b8ec241.s: Educated unemployment in India is predominantly found in:
nc5e8b8ec241.x: Educated unemployment is an urban phenomenon: qualified persons fail to find jobs matching their education and industry's needs.

n1b9260a7c91.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India mainly faces structural and disguised unemployment.
2. Developed countries mainly face disguised unemployment.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n1b9260a7c91.x: India's unemployment is mainly structural and disguised, whereas developed countries mainly face cyclical, demand-deficient unemployment.

nindian-economy-33-3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: Frictional unemployment is associated with transition between jobs.
Underemployment refers to surplus labour with zero marginal output.
Institutional unemployment can arise from regulatory and policy barriers.
Structural unemployment involves a mismatch of skills or geography.
nindian-economy-33-3.x: Surplus labour adding nothing to output is disguised unemployment; underemployment means workers not using their full skills or hours.

n78042d3ab85.s: Technological unemployment, caused by changes in technology, is treated as a subtype of:
n78042d3ab85.x: Technological unemployment results from technological change and is a subtype of structural unemployment.

n2975923f449.s: Why is disguised unemployment generally not captured in PLFS headline unemployment rates?
o: It occurs only in urban areas
The persons concerned appear to be employed
It lasts for less than one week
n2975923f449.x: People in disguised unemployment appear employed, so this hidden form is not captured by headline rates like open unemployment.

n2742bfe4853.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Seasonal and disguised unemployment are mainly rural.
2. Educated unemployment is mainly rural.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n2742bfe4853.x: Seasonal and disguised unemployment are major rural forms, while educated unemployment is predominantly urban.

n91fa1af78a5.s: Under the Usual Principal Status (UPS) approach, a person is treated as employed if he or she worked for at least how many days in the 365-day reference period?
n91fa1af78a5.x: UPS uses a 365-day reference period; working for the major part of it, generally 183 days or more, counts as employed.

n6c297b64cbd.s: Under the UPSS approach, a person is also counted as employed if he or she did subsidiary work for at least ____ in the 365-day reference period.
n6c297b64cbd.x: UPSS includes principal-status workers and those who did subsidiary work for at least 30 days during the year.

n7ad64b4952d.s: In Census terminology, a main worker is one who worked for at least ____ in the year.
n7ad64b4952d.x: A person who worked for 183 days or more is a main worker; less than 183 days makes a marginal worker.

nd10d0b55a5e.s: Which of the following correctly describes the rural–urban pattern of employment?
o: Agriculture 62.0% of rural employment; services 57% of urban employment
Agriculture 57% of rural employment; services 62.0% of urban employment
Agriculture 47% of rural employment; services 62.0% of urban employment
Agriculture 57% of rural employment; services 52% of urban employment
nd10d0b55a5e.x: Agriculture accounted for 57% of rural employment, whereas services accounted for 62.0% of urban employment.

ncd073ac6ca7.s: Agriculture's share of India's workforce declined from 72% in 1951 to ____ in 1993–94.
ncd073ac6ca7.x: Agriculture's workforce share declined from 72% in 1951 to 64.75% in 1993–94.

nb2d4f31496b.s: According to PLFS 2025, India's LFPR, WPR and unemployment rate were approximately:
nb2d4f31496b.x: PLFS 2025 reported LFPR of about 59%, WPR of about 57% and an unemployment rate of about 3%.

n10d90f8ff0f.s: Which programmes were subsumed into NREGA in its districts from 2006?
n10d90f8ff0f.x: NFFWP and SGRY were subsumed into NREGA in the districts it covered from 2006.

n2aad3d237f1.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched in the context of MGNREGA monitoring?
n2aad3d237f1.x: ISRO's Bhuvan supports GeoMGNREGA geo-tagging, while NREGASoft is the programme's Management Information System.

nindian-society-1-17.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-society-1-17.x: NREP began in 1980; the CDP began in 1952, the National Extension Service in 1953 and NSAP in 1995.

n11254b3a466.s: RUDSETI, which trains rural youth for self-employment, was established in 1982 at:
n11254b3a466.x: RUDSETI was set up at Ujire in Karnataka in 1982 and became the model for the present RSETIs.

n1478ae9c71d.s: The change from IRDP to SGSY replaced the individual-beneficiary approach with:
n1478ae9c71d.x: IRDP followed an individual beneficiary approach, whereas SGSY adopted an SHG-based group approach.

n4d16efe56d8.s: The Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP) under DAY-NRLM promotes:
n4d16efe56d8.x: SVEP, launched in 2016, promotes non-farm enterprises among SHG households.

n7e3105fe292.s: In the JAM trinity, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n7e3105fe292.x: Aadhaar provides biometric identity verification; Jan Dhan is the bank account receiving funds and Mobile is the communication channel.

nfbbb3552751.s: Ujjwala provides free LPG connections, to reduce indoor air pollution, to:
nfbbb3552751.x: Ujjwala gives free LPG connections to women of BPL households to reduce indoor air pollution.

nf3ef33c97db.s: Jeevan Pramaan, launched in 2014, enables pensioners to:
o: Create a digital life certificate using Aadhaar biometrics
nf3ef33c97db.x: Jeevan Pramaan (2014) lets pensioners create a digital life certificate using Aadhaar biometrics.

neaf726278e5.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. PMJJBY is a one-year renewable term life insurance scheme.
2. PMSBY covers accidental death and disability.
3. PMSBY provides an old-age pension.
Which of the above statements are correct?
neaf726278e5.x: PMJJBY is term life insurance and PMSBY covers accidental death and disability; PMSBY is not a pension scheme.

n9e822fe99af.s: Under PMSBY, the cover for accidental death or total disability is:
n9e822fe99af.x: PMSBY gives ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total disability and ₹1 lakh for partial disability.

n91c0696d10a.s: A major criticism of the NSAP old-age pension is that inflation has eroded about ____ of its real value.
n91c0696d10a.x: Inflation has eroded nearly half of the real value of the NSAP old-age pension.

na604e085120.s: Which of the following programme – food support pairs is correctly matched?
o: ICDS – Hot cooked meal to school children
na604e085120.x: Food-for-Work gives grain as wages; PDS supplies grain via Fair Price Shops, ICDS supplementary nutrition at anganwadis and PM POSHAN hot cooked meals.

n5d75f84d02c.s: Under the NFSA, pregnant women and lactating mothers are entitled to a free meal and a maternity benefit of at least:
n5d75f84d02c.x: NFSA gives pregnant women and lactating mothers a free meal and a maternity benefit of at least ₹6,000.

n097dbf9e1b3.s:
Which of the following strengthen transparency and accountability in the PDS under the NFSA framework?
1. Social audits
2. Mandatory disclosure of PDS records
3. Vigilance committees
n097dbf9e1b3.x: Social audits, mandatory disclosure of PDS records and vigilance committees are all accountability mechanisms under the NFSA.

n6afa41605f9.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh PDS, ragi (all areas) and jowar (Rayalaseema) may be supplied free of cost in lieu of rice up to:
n6afa41605f9.x: Ragi in all areas and jowar in Rayalaseema may be supplied up to 3 kg per card free of cost in lieu of rice.

n3bec011b25f.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Har Ghar Jal – Rural road connectivity
n3bec011b25f.x: The Community Development Programme (1952) was the first rural development programme; PURA is Abdul Kalam's idea and Har Ghar Jal concerns tap water.

nindian-economy-3-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-economy-3-4.x: IRDP went nationwide on 2 October 1980; NES began in 1953, Food for Work in 1977–78 and IRDP experimentally in 1978–79.

n9420770c1e4.s: PMGSY-II, launched in 2013, focused mainly on:
o: Through routes and major rural links
n9420770c1e4.x: PMGSY-I (2000) gave new connectivity, PMGSY-II (2013) focused on upgradation and PMGSY-III (2019) on through routes and major rural links.
